entities.summary: Valerian, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Sassanid Empire (224–531). Preceded by Sassanid rock reliefs at Naqsh-e Rostam celebrate imperial triumphs. Their legacy influenced Shapur I captures Roman Emperor Valerian at the Battle of Edessa and Khosrow I and Sassanid Zenith.
